subproblem.title: Smooth homotopy identity for a cylinder operator with the slice property (9)
subproblem.statement: Let cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) be an arbitrary family of currents on univ satisfying (9) for cyl: for every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x, v and cyl(X)(ω) = X(η). Then (a) for N ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞, β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) and ρ₁, ρ₀ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with ρ_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s, x))(J ∘ v) for s ∈ {1, 0} and all x and (empty) v: cyl(X)(dβ) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀); (b) for N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞, spt ∂X compact and boundaryMassOn ∂X univ < ∞, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and ρ₁, ρ₀ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with ρ_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_{k+1}) for s ∈ {1, 0} and all x, v: cyl(X)(dβ) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − cyl(∂X)(β). Here d = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ.

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof steps 4 and 5 (the identities cyl(X)(dβ_j) = X(ρ_{1,j}) − X(ρ_{0,j}) [− cyl(∂X)(β_j)] for a fixed j), stated for an arbitrary test form β. Notation: ℝ^N = Euclid N; ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (the point (t, x_1, …, x_N)); Jv := ι(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; D = fderiv ℝ; F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (DF(x)); NC X means IsCompact X.support, X.mass < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞; C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}; d := exteriorDerivative, on test forms exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ m (whose coercion is exteriorDerivative of the coercion, by rfl). Test forms with equal values are equal (Subtype.ext, funext, ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext), and the coercion of a difference of test forms is the pointwise difference.
1. Part (a), normality. For X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N), boundaryMassOn X univ = 0 by definition (degree 0), so X is NC.
2. Part (a), slice. Apply (9) to X (degree 0) and the test form dβ = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ 0 β ∈ 𝒟^1(ℝ^{N+1}): there is η ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt for all x, v, and cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η).
3. Part (a), homotopy identity. By conjunct (d) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms (for N, β, x and the empty tuple v), the integral in step 2 equals β(ι(1, x))(J ∘ v) − β(ι(0, x))(J ∘ v) = ρ₁(x)(v) − ρ₀(x)(v). Hence η = ρ₁ − ρ₀ as test forms, and by linearity of X, cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀).
4. Part (b), normality. For X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N), boundaryMassOn X univ = (∂X).massOn univ = M(∂X) < ∞ (definitions), so X is NC; ∂X is NC by the hypotheses (compact support, M(∂X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn ∂X univ < ∞).
5. Part (b), two slices. Apply (9) to X (degree k + 1) and dβ = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ (k + 1) β ∈ 𝒟^{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}): there is η ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt for v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}, and cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η). Apply (9) to ∂X (degree k) and β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}): there is θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with θ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt for v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, and cyl(∂X)(β) = ∂X(θ) = X(dθ), where dθ = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k θ (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply).
6. Part (b), homotopy identity. By conjunct (c) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms for β and θ (whose hypothesis is the formula for θ in step 5): for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}, ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt = β(ι(1, x))(J ∘ v) − β(ι(0, x))(J ∘ v) − dθ(x)(v) = ρ₁(x)(v) − ρ₀(x)(v) − dθ(x)(v). Hence η = ρ₁ − ρ₀ − dθ as test forms.
7. Conclusion of (b). By linearity, cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − X(dθ) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − cyl(∂X)(β). □

Appendix (informative; the numbered proof above is the contract). The following tactic script was compiled with `lake env lean` after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` (Mathlib 25730c7c) as the `by` block of the declaration `theorem Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_cyl_identity` whose type is exactly this node's frozen lean_statement, with every cited dependency declared under its exact frozen type; it produced no errors or warnings:
  intro cyl h9
  obtain ⟨-, -, hc, hd, -⟩ := Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro N X β ρ₁ ρ₀ hXc hXm hρ₁ hρ₀
    have hXb : boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ := by
      show (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < ∞
      exact ENNReal.zero_lt_top
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hcyl⟩ := h9 N 0 X hXc hXm hXb (exteriorDerivativeTestOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0 β)
    have hηeq : η = ρ₁ - ρ₀ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext x
      ext v
      rw [hη x v]
      have := hd N β x v
      simp only [Submodule.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sub_apply, hρ₁, hρ₀]
      exact this
    rw [hcyl, hηeq]
    exact map_sub X.toCurrent ρ₁ ρ₀
  · intro N k X β ρ₁ ρ₀ hXc hXm hXbm hbc hbb hρ₁ hρ₀
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hcyl⟩ := h9 N (k + 1) X hXc hXm hXbm
      (exteriorDerivativeTestOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1) β)
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hcylb⟩ := h9 N k X.boundary hbc hXbm hbb β
    have hηeq : η = ρ₁ - ρ₀ - exteriorDerivativeTestOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k θ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext x
      ext v
      rw [hη x v]
      have := hc N k β θ hθ x v
      simp only [Submodule.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sub_apply, hρ₁, hρ₀]
      exact this
    rw [hcyl, hcylb, hηeq]
    exact (map_sub X.toCurrent _ _).trans (by rw [map_sub X.toCurrent ρ₁ ρ₀]; rfl)
proof_key_steps: Degree 0: (9) for X and dβ gives η with cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η); slice identity (d) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms gives η = ρ₁ − ρ₀.
Degree k+1: (9) for X and dβ gives η; (9) for ∂X and β gives θ with cyl(∂X)(β) = ∂X(θ) = X(dθ).
Slice identity (c) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms gives η = ρ₁ − ρ₀ − dθ; linearity of X yields the identity.

audit.reason: The degree-zero convention and explicit normality hypotheses justify both uses of (9). The inherited slice identities, test-form extensionality and boundary evaluation formula yield the exact signs and degrees in both conclusions.
